plain_description.what: A design document (docs/design/FRAMEWORK.md), written by a multi-agent workflow from the results ledger. It is a framework for judging and ranking every model on every question. Every rule is traced to a recorded result and its current status. No calls.
plain_description.why: Before spending on more judged runs, the project needed one consistent design that uses no withdrawn result and states its limits.
plain_description.information: It gives the rules to follow, the open limits, and the tests to register first: 19 zero-call and 5 judged. Result: done. Three record errors were found and fixed at synthesis, and some framework lines were later corrected. It is a design, not evidence. Its references to arena-pool judged numbers are design provenance only. It refuses a frontier order, sub-cell rows and the word 'calibrated'.
